Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Vigilante** (विजिलांटे): A person who takes the law into their own hands without legal authority.

 
 
• **Example:** The vigilante decided to protect his neighborhood from criminals.
 
 
 
• **Masquerade** (मास्करेड): A false show or disguise, or a party where masks are worn.
 
 
• **Example:** He attended the masquerade ball wearing a mysterious mask.
 
 
 
• **Caricature** (कैरिकेचर): A representation of a person or thing in which certain characteristics are exaggerated for comic or grotesque effect.
 
 
• **Example:** The artist made a caricature of the politician, emphasizing his large nose.
